requirements.evidence: Evaluator and deep fixtures produce deterministic context ratios.
Ambiguous proxy action returned PAUSED before execution.
Risky action moved PAUSED -> PROCEED after reviewer approval; trajectory persisted.
12-case benchmark reports baseline 0/10 and solution 10/10 unsafe actions caught.
Deep evaluation records p50/p95 local latency below 25 ms.
FastAPI contract works, but v0.1 returns a simulated completion rather than forwarding to a live upstream provider.
Declared stdio tools work, but transport is a lightweight JSON adapter rather than the official MCP SDK protocol.
Safe function proceeds and paused function is never invoked.
Root SKILL.md requires structured proposals and stop-on-pause behavior.
Decision and approval trajectories persist to trajectories/364a85ba-f3e6-49a2-90ca-9922cf5204bd.json.
Safe path used fast; irreversible path used escalated.
No live Groq, Gemini Flash, or Ollama adapter is implemented or measured yet; offline verifier is the reproducible default.
Approval endpoints exist in proxy.py, but the planned interfaces/webhooks.py module is not yet split out.
Token telemetry is deterministic and repeatable, but uses a regex approximation rather than a model-specific tokenizer.
